## Every `>` container is a `Callout`

The examples of the [base module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/base.md)
and the [callouts module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/callouts.md) whose
behavior `M3` landed: every source container introduced by `>` is a `Callout`
with `variant=null`, `collapsed=null`, and no title, and the inherited prefix,
laziness, continuation, blank-line, and nesting rules are unchanged. The
metadata rule that gives a callout its `variant`, `collapsed`, and title arrives
with `O8`, so only the module's metadata-free examples are here; they are in
the module's order. The expected dumps are the modules' expected dumps in the
dump grammar of today, which does not yet print the universal `anchor` and
`attributes` fields that `M7` lands, so every line differs from the module's
by exactly ` anchor=null attributes={}` and by nothing else.

The base module's example: a plain quoted block, a lazy continuation, and a
nested container:

```````````````````````````````` example
> quoted
> lazy
continued

> > nested
.
Document scope=1:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
│       ├── Text scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quoted" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       ├── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="lazy" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       └── Text scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="continued" children=0
└── Callout scope=5:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Callout scope=5:3..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=5:5..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=5:5..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="nested" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The callouts module's examples. A plain quoted block is a callout without
metadata:

```````````````````````````````` example
> quote
.
Document scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quote" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A `]`, or a fold marker, that is not followed by a space, a tab, or the end
of the line is not a metadata line, and neither is a marker that is not at the
first position, so the callout is metadata-free and the bytes are content:

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note]Title

> [!faq]+Title

> x [!note]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]Title" children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:3..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!faq]+Title" children=0
└── Callout scope=5:1..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=5:3..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x [!note]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A blank first line means no metadata:

```````````````````````````````` example
>
> [!note] x
.
Document scope=1:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note] x" children=0
````````````````````````````````
